title: Final Partition Functions
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the partition functions for Fermi, Bose, and Boltzmann statistics.

title: Final Energies
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the energies corresponding to each partition function.

title: Configurations Enumeration
description: Important Criteria: The student should enumerate the configurations for each statistical case clearly.

title: Boltzmann Condition Discussion
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately discuss the conditions under which Fermions and Bosons can be treated as Boltzmann particles.

title: Sign and Factor Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in their calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.
